subject: Jensen Huang wants back in, board says no; Nvidia Q3 revenue up 103% YoY
notes: Issue is headed 'Tue, Nov 17'. Headlines only; no event dates stated for the deals.

stories.headline: Anthropic guiding IPO investors to pricing at or above the high end of its $70 to $78 range (sources)
stories.quote: SOURCES: ANTHROPIC IS GUIDING PROSPECTIVE IPO INVESTORS THAT IT EXPECTS TO PRICE ITS SHARES AT OR ABOVE THE HIGH END OF ITS $70 TO $78 MARKETED RANGE

facts.text: Marketed IPO price range is $70 to $78 per share; expects to price at or above the high end (sources)
facts.quote: IT EXPECTS TO PRICE ITS SHARES AT OR ABOVE THE HIGH END OF ITS $70 TO $78 MARKETED RANGE

facts.text: SEC filing: Amazon and Google set to hold nearly 15% and 14% of Anthropic's outstanding capital stock after the IPO and private placement
facts.quote: SEC FILING: AMAZON AND GOOGLE ARE SET TO HOLD NEARLY 15% AND 14% OF ANTHROPIC'S OUTSTANDING CAPITAL STOCK, RESPECTIVELY, AFTER ITS IPO AND PRIVATE PLACEMENT

facts.text: Anthropic Direct data center network plans commit $900B+ through 2045; docs show it will lease ~875K TPUs for ~$7.2B per year
facts.quote: A LOOK AT ANTHROPIC'S DATA CENTER NETWORK PLANS, DUBBED ANTHROPIC DIRECT, COMMITTING $900B+ THROUGH 2045; DOCS SHOW IT WILL LEASE ~875K TPUS FOR ~$7.2B PER YEAR

stories.headline: AppLovin among companies in talks to acquire ad tech company Criteo (sources)

facts.text: Criteo has a ~$1B market cap after its stock fell 50%+ over the past five years
facts.quote: CRITEO, WHICH HAS A ~$1B MARKET CAP AFTER ITS STOCK FELL 50%+ OVER THE PAST FIVE YEARS

stories.headline: OpenAI GPT-6.2 Astra priced at $8/1M input and $40/1M output tokens; GPT-6.2 Sol keeps $2/$10
stories.quote: GPT-6.2 ASTRA COSTS $8/1M INPUT AND $40/1M OUTPUT TOKENS, DOWN 20% FROM GPT-6 ASTRA; GPT-6.2 SOL KEEPS GPT-6.1 SOL'S $2/1M INPUT AND $10/1M OUTPUT TOKEN PRICING

facts.text: GPT-6.2 Astra: $8 per 1M input tokens and $40 per 1M output tokens, down 20% from GPT-6 Astra
facts.quote: GPT-6.2 ASTRA COSTS $8/1M INPUT AND $40/1M OUTPUT TOKENS, DOWN 20% FROM GPT-6 ASTRA

facts.text: GPT-6.2 Sol keeps GPT-6.1 Sol's pricing: $2 per 1M input tokens and $10 per 1M output tokens
facts.quote: GPT-6.2 SOL KEEPS GPT-6.1 SOL'S $2/1M INPUT AND $10/1M OUTPUT TOKEN PRICING

facts.text: OpenAI says Astra sets records on work and science evals at under a third of GPT-6 Astra's cost
facts.quote: OPENAI DEBUTS GPT-6.2 ASTRA AND SOL IN CHATGPT WORK, CODEX, AND API, SAYING ASTRA SETS RECORDS ON WORK AND SCIENCE EVALS AT UNDER A THIRD OF GPT-6 ASTRA'S COST

facts.text: Artificial Analysis has GPT-6.2 Astra trailing only Claude Fable 5.2 in its main index; Epoch AI has them tied
facts.quote: ARTIFICIAL ANALYSIS SHOWS GPT-6.2 ASTRA TRAILING ONLY CLAUDE FABLE 5.2 IN ITS MAIN INDEX, FLAT VS. GPT-6 ASTRA IN CODING; EPOCH AI HAS ASTRA TIED WITH FABLE 5.2

stories.headline: Microsoft says MAI Code 2 has 98% of GPT-6.1 Sol's performance at 40% of the price
stories.quote: MICROSOFT UNVEILS SIX AI MODELS SPANNING CODING, CYBERSECURITY, IMAGES, AND VOICE, SAYING MAI CODE 2 HAS 98% OF GPT-6.1 SOL'S PERFORMANCE AT 40% OF THE PRICE

facts.text: Microsoft's own claim: MAI Code 2 at 40% of GPT-6.1 Sol's price; no absolute price stated
facts.quote: MAI CODE 2 HAS 98% OF GPT-6.1 SOL'S PERFORMANCE AT 40% OF THE PRICE

stories.headline: Jensen Huang says he would be honored to return as Nvidia CEO; chair says board does not intend to reinstate him
stories.quote: JENSEN HUANG BREAKS HIS SILENCE, SAYING HE “WOULD BE HONORED” TO RETURN IF THE BOARD DECIDES IT IS IN THE “BEST INTEREST” OF SHAREHOLDERS, STAFF, AND THE US

facts.text: On the Q3 earnings call, chair Harvey Jones said the board does not intend to reinstate Huang as CEO
facts.quote: ON Q3 EARNINGS CALL, NVIDIA CHAIR HARVEY JONES SAYS THE BOARD DOES NOT INTEND TO REINSTATE JENSEN HUANG AS CEO

facts.text: Sources: Nvidia director Nader Khalil wrote to the board that not reinstating Huang could cost irreplaceable talent
facts.quote: SOURCES: NVIDIA DIRECTOR OF DEVELOPER TECH NADER KHALIL WROTE TO THE BOARD ARGUING THAT NOT REINSTATING JENSEN HUANG COULD COST NVIDIA “IRREPLACEABLE TALENT”

facts.text: Huang will appear before the House Foreign Affairs, Intelligence and China Select committees on December 1
facts.quote: JENSEN HUANG WILL APPEAR BEFORE THE HOUSE FOREIGN AFFAIRS, INTELLIGENCE, AND CHINA SELECT COMMITTEES ON DECEMBER 1, PER THE LEADERS OF THE PANELS

stories.headline: Nvidia reports Q3 revenue up 103% YoY to $115.8B, above estimates
stories.quote: NVIDIA REPORTS Q3 REVENUE UP 103% YOY TO $115.8B, ABOVE $109.1B EST., DATA CENTER REVENUE UP 110% TO $107.6B, AND FORECASTS Q4 REVENUE ABOVE ESTIMATES

facts.text: Q3 revenue $115.8B, up 103% YoY, versus $109.1B estimate; data center revenue $107.6B, up 110%
facts.quote: NVIDIA REPORTS Q3 REVENUE UP 103% YOY TO $115.8B, ABOVE $109.1B EST., DATA CENTER REVENUE UP 110% TO $107.6B

facts.text: Interim CEO Colette Kress says Nvidia will stay disciplined and selective in supporting neoclouds; CoreWeave and Nebius rose 9%+ after hours
facts.quote: NVIDIA INTERIM CEO COLETTE KRESS SAYS THE COMPANY WILL STAY “DISCIPLINED AND SELECTIVE” IN SUPPORTING NEOCLOUDS; COREWEAVE AND NEBIUS JUMP 9%+ AFTER HOURS

stories.headline: Nvidia will no longer sell H200 chips in China
stories.quote: COLETTE KRESS SAYS NVIDIA WILL NO LONGER SELL H200 CHIPS IN CHINA, ENDING ITS ROLE IN A DEAL BROKERED BY HUANG AND TRUMP THAT LET THE US COLLECT A 25% TARIFF

stories.headline: Sources: US SEC is investigating Nvidia, including whether its disclosures misled investors
stories.quote: SOURCES: THE US SEC IS INVESTIGATING NVIDIA, INCLUDING WHETHER THE COMPANY'S DISCLOSURES MISLED INVESTORS

facts.text: Nvidia's board established a National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee
facts.quote: NVIDIA'S BOARD ESTABLISHES A NATIONAL SECURITY AND EXPORT CONTROL OVERSIGHT COMMITTEE TO OVERSEE NATIONAL SECURITY POLICIES, EXPORT CONTROL COMPLIANCE, AND MORE

facts.text: US Commerce Department says it began probing Megaspeed in 2024; Nvidia put Megaspeed on its no-sell list in June 2025
facts.quote: THE US COMMERCE DEPARTMENT SAYS IT BEGAN PROBING MEGASPEED IN 2024 OVER POSSIBLE EXPORT RULE VIOLATIONS; NVIDIA PUT MEGASPEED ON ITS “NO SELL” LIST IN JUNE 2025

stories.headline: Calif says it used GPT-6 Cyber to find a Java RCE flaw dubbed Java4Shell; Oracle has released a patch
stories.quote: CYBERSECURITY STARTUP CALIF SAYS IT USED GPT-6 CYBER TO UNCOVER AN RCE FLAW IN JAVA DUBBED “JAVA4SHELL”; ORACLE HAS RELEASED A PATCH

stories.headline: Sources: NSA Net, the NSA's classified internal network, is down; no evidence of a cyberattack so far
stories.quote: SOURCES: NSA NET, THE HIGHLY CLASSIFIED NETWORK THAT THE NSA USES FOR ITS INTERNAL COMMUNICATIONS, IS DOWN; AT THIS POINT, THERE IS NO EVIDENCE OF A CYBERATTACK

facts.text: DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin says recent tech outages are not tied to cyberattacks
facts.quote: US DHS SECRETARY MARKWAYNE MULLIN SAYS RECENT TECH OUTAGES ARE NOT TIED TO CYBERATTACKS BUT TO “PUSHING NEW TECHNOLOGY ON TOP OF REALLY OLD COMPUTER SYSTEMS”

stories.headline: California bans Waymo robotaxis from freeways; Waymo halts freeway service nationwide
stories.quote: CALIFORNIA BANS WAYMO ROBOTAXIS FROM FREEWAYS AFTER A VIRAL VIDEO SHOWED ONE FAILING TO YIELD TO THE HIGHWAY PATROL; WAYMO HALTS FREEWAY SERVICE NATIONWIDE

stories.quote: SOURCES: TAKE-TWO'S FIRAXIS, WHICH MAKES THE CIVILIZATION AND XCOM FRANCHISES, LAYS OFF 33% OF ITS STAFF, OR ~60 JOBS; STUDIO HEAD HEATHER HAZEN WILL ALSO LEAVE
